sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 19.10.2023 CRL.M.A. 28820/2023Exemption 1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is accordingly disposed of.

3. The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:-
"(a) Quash the Order dated 12.04.2023 passed in criminal complaint being Ct. Case No. 1105/21 passed by the Ld. Metropolitan Magistrate- 11, Dwarka Courts, Delhi.
(b) Quash the First Information Report being FIR No. 102/2023 dated 12.04.2023 lodged by P.S. Janakpuri u/s 420/34 I.P.C;
(c) Pass such other order(s) as this Hon'ble Court may deem -fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner draws the attention of this Court to the order dated 28.03.2022 passed by the learned Trial Court during the pendency of the application under Section This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text:
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/10/2023 at 00:32:57 156 (3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, filed by the respondent no.2.
5.

It is pointed out that during the course of the said proceedings, it was brought to the notice of the learned Trial Court that respondent no.2/complainant in the said complaint case had approached the RERA wherein an award was passed which was subsequently challenged before the Delhi High Court and the said order has been stayed.
It is reflected in the said order that the same was sought to be verified from the Investigating Officer by way of filing an ATR in the said respect.
6. It is further stated that the impugned order dated 12.04.2023, whereby the FIR was directed to be registered, does not mention about the said ATR or the aforesaid fact.

Learned Senior Counsel submits that without prejudice to the aforesaid facts, the petitioners are ready and willing to settle the dispute with respondent no.2.
7.
Issue notice.
8. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.

9. On the petitioner taking necessary steps, issue notice to respondent no.2, by all permissible modes, including through electronic mail, returnable on 05.12.2023.
10.
On the applicant joining the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant till the next date of hearing.
11. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court, forthwith.
AMIT SHARMA, J OCTOBER 19, 2023/nk
